capabilities: chat with the AI Linzi assistant in a sidebar with vault-aware tools
search and read Markdown, PDF, DOCX, HTML, PPTX, and XLSX files locally
create, update, and delete vault files through previewed, confirmation-gated change sets
generate article illustrations and HTML/DOCX/PDF/PPTX deliverables
format and publish articles to WeChat and convert them to Xiaohongshu notes
extras: Desktop-only, requires Obsidian 1.11.4+. Connection key comes from chat.alinalinzi.com; service-side prompts and orchestration are closed source. Some AI features consume credits. The public repository is a thin client for a private cloud service.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat that can search the vault, edit notes under confirmation, and publish content to Chinese social platforms.

relations.evidence: WeChat draft publishing connects to the official WeChat API.
When a user explicitly selects Fish Audio for Article to Video narration
checks for existing Node.js 22+, FFmpeg/FFprobe, and HyperFrames 0.8.15 installations
PDF.js is bundled for local extraction of text-based PDFs.

AI Linzi credits or paid entitlement for some features

Node.js 22+, FFmpeg/FFprobe, HyperFrames for Article to Video

summary: Cloud AI assistant service (AI Linzi) with sidebar chat, local vault search, note editing, image generation, and WeChat/Xiaohongshu publishing workflows.
